data_fields.name: penalty_floor_minutes
data_fields.donor_constant: -32768 (int16 field; the wrap the sketch avoids)

data_fields.name: restriction_bitmask
data_fields.donor_constant: 15 (1 chat, 2 skill, 4 command, 8 item; 16 room off)

best_idea: A chat penalty is one signed counter in minutes (negative = muted) that decays one minute per online minute, so every penalty source writes to one number.
decision_why: Keep the signed-minutes counter and the decay, store it as a wall-clock expiry per character (one character, one ledger), and clamp it in server math; reject the int16 field, the client-chosen report length and the self-mute branch as written.
acceptance: A server test applies a 65535-minute penalty and asserts the stored penalty is clamped to the 14-day floor and the next chat line is refused; a 10-minute penalty lifts 10 wall-clock minutes later even if the player logs out in between.
